what: Per-round timing emission is scoped only to post-revise/post-apply
scenario_or_breakage: Early `_snapshot_terminal_exit_preserving_status` exits (converged, cap-hit, degraded-empty-collector, tally-error, panel-failed, revision-failed) never run revise/post-apply, so many completed Step 3 rounds would emit no `rounds[]` row
suggested_fix: Mount emission in `_snapshot_terminal_exit_preserving_status` (skip when `LOOP_STATUS=main-agent-vote-required`) or equivalent single exit hook; set `_round_end` immediately before calling the record helper
